verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents query metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards in natural language, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. Agent Skills and a plugin add further agent support. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup and authentication details such as self-hosted versus cloud endpoints and the tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Query metrics, traces, logs, alerts, and dashboards through natural language.
